sermon.title: How Important is the Bible in Being a Christian? — September 29, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: All Scripture is inspired and essential to the Christian walk. The world’s wisdom cannot answer Jesus, and twisting Scripture leads to destruction. We are saved by grace for good works, will appear before Christ’s judgment seat, and must love God and people—practicing righteousness.

The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, And saves such as have a contrite spirit. Many are the afflictions of the righteous, But the LORD delivers him out of them all.
